name: astro-observation-planner
description: Use this skill when both of these are present: (1) a night or time reference — "tonight", "tomorrow", "this weekend", "Saturday night", or any specific date; (2) observing intent — stargazing, skywatching, telescope or binocular use, wanting to know what's visible or "up", asking whether a specific object (planet, galaxy, nebula, cluster) can be seen, or planning any kind of sky-watching session. None of these needs to be stated formally — "what's up from Austin tonight" and "going skywatching in Champaign tomorrow" both qualify. Outputs twilight windows, Moon phase, planetary visibility, and a filtered deep-sky catalog. Do not trigger for general astronomy education, equipment setup, or conceptual questions lacking location + night + observing intent.
